goal: Turn this grandmother's folktale manuscript into an illustrated audiobook video — calm narration with one watercolor picture per scene: In the old bamboo forest, a stray kitten named Mochi finds a glowing river stone that grants her one wish before sunrise.
rationale: User supplied a complete prose folktale and explicitly asks for an illustrated audiobook video with one watercolor picture per scene. This is chain (c) illustrated-storytelling: Narration writes the narrator-voice script + segment-aligned image_prompts + a watercolor overall_style, Illustration generates one anchored image per segment, Narrator TTS-es each line + emits per-segment timing + SRT, Compositor concatenates the image sequence with narrator audio and burns the subtitles. No StoryAgent / ScreenplayAgent / KeyFrameAgent / VideoAgent (cinematic chain) and no background score (user didn't ask for music).

plan.intent: Write a gentle fairytale-style narrator script from the bamboo-forest kitten folktale, split into 6-10 watercolor-suitable scene segments
Generate one soft watercolor illustration per narration segment, anchored to the first-scene style
TTS every narration line with a warm calm voice, concatenate with gentle pauses, emit timed SRT + per-segment timing
Render the illustration slideshow against the narrator audio, burn English subtitles, export final mp4

goal: 把这个《二十四节气》绘本短故事做成有声版：每个节气配一幅国画风格插图，配旁白朗读
rationale: 用户给了完整的节气绘本短故事，明确要求『有声版 + 每个节气一幅国画风格插图 + 旁白朗读』。这是 chain (c) 插图叙事链：NarrationAgent 改写为适合朗读的中文节气叙述脚本、按节气切段并生成中国水墨风格的 overall_style + 每段 image_prompt；IllustrationAgent 用第一节气的水墨风做 anchor，其余并行 edit_image 保持画风一致；NarratorAgent 中文 TTS 每句并导出 SRT + segment_timing；CompositorAgent 把 24 张图按节气时长切换 + 叠旁白音 + 烧中文字幕。不加 Music/Ambience（用户只说了旁白）。

plan.intent: 将二十四节气绘本改写为中文旁白脚本，按节气切 6-12 个视觉段，并为每段写中国水墨风格的画面 prompt
按中国水墨风格生成每段的国画插图，第一张做 anchor 保证所有节气画风统一
中文 TTS 朗读每句旁白并拼接，输出整段 narrator wav + 每段时长 + 中文 SRT
按 segment_timing 拼接水墨插图序列、mux 旁白音频、烧中文字幕，导出最终 mp4

goal: Make this Aesop fable (The Boy Who Cried Wolf) into a narrated picture-book video for kids — one bright cartoon illustration per story beat
rationale: User explicitly asks for a narrated picture-book video from a known fable with one cartoon illustration per story beat. Chain (c) illustrated-storytelling: NarrationAgent rewrites the fable in child-friendly narrator voice, segments by story beat (shepherd boy's first cry / second cry / the actual wolf / village consequence), sets a bright flat-cartoon overall_style; IllustrationAgent anchors on a cheerful opening scene then edits the rest parallel; NarratorAgent does friendly TTS + timing + SRT; Compositor mp4. No music — user just said 'narrated', not 'with a score'.

plan.intent: Rewrite The Boy Who Cried Wolf as a kid-friendly picture-book narrator script with bright flat-cartoon style, segmented by story beat
Render one bright cartoon illustration per story beat, anchoring the cross-beat style to the first illustration
TTS each narrator line in a warm kid-story voice, concatenate with light pauses, emit English SRT + segment timing
Composite the illustrated slideshow, mux narrator audio, burn English subtitles, export mp4
